panes.title: Workers
panes.summary: Every Worker's /api/build: the commit it serves, and whether it is main's head.

panes.title: Lead funnel
panes.summary: Leads by status.

panes.title: Delivery summary
panes.summary: The counts the monitor reads over the last day.
panes.empty: The delivery ledger is not available.

panes.title: Leads
panes.summary: Newest first. Open a lead, set its status or export the list through the API (getLead, updateLead, exportLeads).

panes.title: Form deliveries
panes.summary: The receipt and the owner's notification of every submission. A failed one is retried through the comms engine (retryDelivery).

panes.title: Owner-alert failures
panes.summary: Owner notifications that failed or are still pending, and failed operator dispatches.
panes.empty: No owner alert has failed in the window.

panes.title: Inbound mail
panes.summary: Sender as the hash the table stores, the receiving mailbox, the forward per destination and the autoreply state.
panes.empty: No inbound message, or the inbound table is not deployed yet.

panes.title: Autoreplies
panes.summary: Inbound autoreplies by state over the window.
panes.empty: No autoreply in the window, or the inbound table is not deployed yet.

panes.title: Form receipts
panes.summary: Receipts sent to submitters by status over the window.

panes.title: Suppressions
panes.summary: Recipients the engine will not write to, as hashes. Add and remove through the API (addSuppression, removeSuppression).

panes.title: Stakeholders
panes.summary: The stakeholder registry of the core repository.

panes.title: Metrics
panes.summary: The metric registry.

panes.title: Report types
panes.summary: The report types and who reads them.

panes.title: Findings rules
panes.summary: Each rule with the metrics that are its evidence.

panes.title: Commitments
panes.summary: What the company promises, and whether it is implemented.

panes.title: Legal documents
panes.summary: Each document with what blocks its publication.

panes.title: Configuration
panes.summary: Names the Worker reads, and whether each is set. Values are never shown.

panes.title: Bindings
panes.summary: Databases, services and assets the Worker needs.

panes.title: Planned resources
panes.summary: The names this Worker will have, against the naming registry.

panes.title: Audit log
panes.summary: Every admin action, newest first. Append-only; the actor is a hash of the Access email.
panes.empty: No action has been taken yet.

panes.title: Users
panes.summary: Who can use the admin, as hashes. Access itself is the Cloudflare Access policy and the allowlist secret.

panes.title: Roles (RBAC)
panes.summary: The permissions each role holds; every API operation names the permission it needs.

panes.title: Invitations
panes.summary: Recorded invitations (hashes). They grant nothing until the lead widens the Access policy. Create and revoke through the API.

panes.summary: Revenue, plans and cloud cost
